notes: NONLINEAR: spot check 2026-10-08: the paper reports a bivariate DSEM, rendered in words as the nonlinear rows are; the lagged predictors are not columns of the table. Paper's model is a dynamic structural equation model in Mplus (D ~ D_lag + G_lag + subculture + D_lag:subculture + G_lag:subculture + (1 + D_lag + G_lag | participant)). The lagged terms are not columns (lags of drbl and fem or masc within ID ordered by ts), so only the between-person term subculture (0 none, 1 jocks, 2 bears, 3 twinks, 4 fat gay men) and the participant grouping are rendered. drbl is state sexual desirability, the mean of des and att (script: dsbl = (des + att)/2); fem and masc are the two state gender responses, filed in ignore.
